title: `@7.0.0-dev.1` runs into `dependency outside of npm` in deno
body:
### Describe the bug

Just an fyi. I was curious about the new kysley backend and tried installing the dev branch into my deno project. 


```
error: Error in @mikro-orm/knex@7.0.0-dev.1 parsing version requirement for dependency "kysely": "https://pkg.pr.new/kysely-org/kysely/kysely@2b7007e"
    0: Package specified a dependency outside of npm (https://pkg.pr.new/kysely-org/kysely/kysely@2b7007e). Deno does not install these for security reasons. The npm package should be improved to have all its dependencies on npm.
```

### Reproduction

import_map.json
```
{
  "imports": {
    "@mikro-orm/core": "npm:@mikro-orm/core@7.0.0-dev.1",
    "@mikro-orm/sqlite": "npm:@mikro-orm/sqlite@7.0.0-dev.1",
    "@mikro-orm/migrations": "npm:@mikro-orm/migrations@7.0.0-dev.1",
  }
} 
```

deno.jsonc
``` 
{
  "nodeModulesDir": "auto",
  "importMap": "./import_map.json",
  // ...
}
```

 and then run `deno install`.

### What driver are you using?

@mikro-orm/sqlite

### MikroORM version

@7.0.0-dev.1

### Node.js version

deno 2.1

### Operating system

_No response_
